themes.label: Legal rules against AI weaponization
themes.definition: Calls for legal rules to prevent the weaponization of AI as part of new governance structures for emerging domains.
themes.inclusion: Passages calling for legal rules or norms preventing AI weaponization.
themes.exclusion: Cyberspace or outer space norms without AI (not AI themes).
themes.boundary_cases: When AI weaponization is one item among cyber and space norms, code this plus AI_GLOBAL_GOVERNANCE.

examples.quote: forming legal rules that will prevent the weaponization of artificial intelligence

themes.label: New structures for emerging technologies
themes.definition: Need for new international structures and norms to govern rapid advances in emerging domains, including AI.
themes.inclusion: Passages calling for new global structures/norms covering AI among other domains.
themes.boundary_cases: National preparation paired with global structures counts here for the global part.

examples.quote: we need new structures to govern rapid advances in other areas

value.rationale: The single Philippine passage places AI among emerging domains needing new international governance structures, specifically legal rules against AI weaponization.
